title: utia-gc/demultiplex-in-line params.samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet used as input to utia-gc/demultiplex-in-line

sample_fastq_prefix.errorMessage: Sample FASTQ prefix must be provided and cannot contain spaces

multiplexed_fastq_file_path_r1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

multiplexed_fastq_file_path_r2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
